verses.pali: Yo ca avinaye vinayasaññī, yo ca vinaye avinayasaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives what is not the training as the training, and one who perceives what is the training as not the training.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements grow.”
